summary: Extensibility model for default informational goals and audit behaviors (Epic #218 / Feature #226)

entries.migration_impact: Extensions can now provide informational goals via provided_by in catalog (or future manifest per extension design). Core audit and bootstrap consume platform + extension goals transparently. Example extension goals added for demo.
entries.agent_notes: Catalog goals now have 'provided_by'. Use plate_informational_goals to see platform vs extension. Audit includes all with include_defaults. See extension-repository.md for author guidance on contributing via plate-extension.yml.
